theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_bounded_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (M R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ R₀ → (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖g x - g z‖ ≤ M * ‖x - z‖) → (∀ x ∈ A, ‖g x‖ ≤ R₀) → ∃ f : Rn n → Rn ℓ, (∀ x ∈ A, f x = g x) ∧ (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ℓ * M * ‖x - z‖) ∧ ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ R₀
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
